name: 60603 · Chicago, IL
findings: ZIP 60603 (Chicago) has 1,954 nonprofit organizations. 275 of them (14%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 230 organizations.
Foundation organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (16% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 60603 (Chicago) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
75% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 60603 (Chicago) list civic or political action on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 141.2 times the typical level).
